sentences.hanzi: 大雪快到了，天气越来越冷。
sentences.pinyin: Dàxuě kuài dào le, tiānqì yuè lái yuè lěng.
sentences.english: Major Snow is almost here, and the weather is getting colder and colder.

sentences.hanzi: 早上，小明和丽丽去爷爷家。
sentences.pinyin: Zǎoshang, Xiǎomíng hé Lìlì qù yéye jiā.
sentences.english: In the morning, Xiaoming and Lili went to their grandpa's house.

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷正在准备腌腊肉。
sentences.pinyin: Yéye zhèngzài zhǔnbèi yān làròu.
sentences.english: Grandpa was getting ready to make cured meat.

sentences.hanzi: 小明说：“爷爷，我来帮您切肉。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng shuō: "Yéye, wǒ lái bāng nín qiē ròu."
sentences.english: Xiaoming said, "Grandpa, let me help you cut the meat."

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽也说：“我也来帮忙，我们一起做。”
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì yě shuō: "Wǒ yě lái bāngmáng, wǒmen yīqǐ zuò."
sentences.english: Lili also said, "I'll help too, let's do it together."

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷笑着说：“好，你们真懂事。”
sentences.pinyin: Yéye xiàozhe shuō: "Hǎo, nǐmen zhēn dǒngshì."
sentences.english: Grandpa smiled and said, "Good, you're so thoughtful."

sentences.hanzi: 他们先洗肉，再放盐和调料。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen xiān xǐ ròu, zài fàng yán hé tiáoliào.
sentences.english: They first washed the meat, then added salt and seasonings.

sentences.hanzi: 小明问：“爷爷，为什么要腌肉？”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng wèn: "Yéye, wèishénme yào yān ròu?"
sentences.english: Xiaoming asked, "Grandpa, why do we need to cure the meat?"

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷说：“大雪前后腌肉，味道好，也能放很久。”
sentences.pinyin: Yéye shuō: "Dàxuě qiánhòu yān ròu, wèidào hǎo, yě néng fàng hěn jiǔ."
sentences.english: Grandpa said, "Curing meat around Major Snow makes it taste better and last longer."

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽说：“我明白了，这是冬天的方法。”
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì shuō: "Wǒ míngbai le, zhè shì dōngtiān de fāngfǎ."
sentences.english: Lili said, "I understand now; this is a winter method."

sentences.hanzi: 这时候，妈妈从厨房走出来。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shíhou, māma cóng chúfáng zǒu chūlái.
sentences.english: Just then, Mom came out of the kitchen.

sentences.hanzi: 她煮了热腾腾的红枣姜茶。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zhǔ le rè téngténg de hóngzǎo jiāng chá.
sentences.english: She made steaming hot red date ginger tea.

sentences.hanzi: 妈妈对大家说：“茶好了，快来喝吧。”
sentences.pinyin: Māma duì dàjiā shuō: "Chá hǎo le, kuài lái hē ba."
sentences.english: Mom said to everyone, "The tea is ready, come and drink it."

sentences.hanzi: 爸爸说：“大雪时节，要多吃温热食物，注意保暖。”
sentences.pinyin: Bàba shuō: "Dàxuě shíjié, yào duō chī wēnrè shíwù, zhùyì bǎonuǎn."
sentences.english: Dad said, "During Major Snow, we should eat more warm foods and keep warm."

sentences.hanzi: 小明喝了一口姜茶，说：“真好喝，身体暖和了。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng hē le yī kǒu jiāng chá, shuō: "Zhēn hǎo hē, shēntǐ nuǎnhuo le."
sentences.english: Xiaoming took a sip of ginger tea and said, "It's really good; I feel warm now."

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽也说：“红枣甜甜的，我喜欢。”
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì yě shuō: "Hóngzǎo tiántián de, wǒ xǐhuān."
sentences.english: Lili also said, "The red dates are sweet; I like them."

sentences.hanzi: 一家人坐在一起喝茶，心里很温暖。
sentences.pinyin: Yī jiā rén zuò zài yīqǐ hē chá, xīnli hěn wēnnuǎn.
sentences.english: The family sat together drinking tea, feeling very warm inside.

sentences.hanzi: 他们看着窗外，盼望着第一场雪。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen kàn zhe chuāng wài, pànwàng zhe dì yī cháng xuě.
sentences.english: They looked out the window, looking forward to the first snow.

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷说：“雪快来了，今年一定很好。”
sentences.pinyin: Yéye shuō: "Xuě kuài lái le, jīnnián yīdìng hěn hǎo."
sentences.english: Grandpa said, "The snow is coming soon; this year is sure to be good."

sentences.hanzi: 大家都笑了。
sentences.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu xiào le.
sentences.english: Everyone laughed.

sentences.hanzi: 这个冬天，虽然冷，但是一家人的爱让家很温暖。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dōngtiān, suīrán lěng, dànshì yī jiā rén de ài ràng jiā hěn wēnnuǎn.
sentences.english: This winter, although it is cold, the family's love makes home very warm.
